title: NBI for Early Diagnosis of OPMD/OSCC
official: Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) for Early Diagnosis of Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma (OSCC) and Oral Potentially Malignant Disorders (OPMD)
summary: Early detection - possibly at its pre-malignant stages (Oral Potentially Malignant Disorders, OPMD) - with periodic surveillance is thus fundamental for limiting disease burden, hopefully reducing the incidence of advanced stages OSCC and increasing survival. Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) has proved itself as promising tool for helping clinician both for diagnosis and therapy. Yet, there is no definitive scientific evidence that NBI is superior to common oral examination with white light (WLOE) for diagnosing OSCC/OPMD. We thus propose a randomised clinical trial understand its role in this field.
